summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms in the MONAI repo, uncommitted. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gets Lambda appended (asserts callable with "func must be callable", stores self.func). monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py gets Lambda import, typing line now "from typing import Callable, Optional", Lambdad class (MapTransform base, internal self.lambd = Lambda(func), shallow dict copy applying to each key), and alias "LambdaD = LambdaDict = Lambdad". docs/source/transforms.rst gets Lambda entry before SplitChannel and Lambdad entry after ConcatItemsd. New tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py cover identity, spatial-only slicing, unlisted-key preservation, keys view, iterable callable applied whole, and non-callable AssertionError. Verified by reading only: diff of dictionary module contains only the permitted changes; no lines exceed 120 columns. Tests, flake8 and black were not run, per instructions.
